summary: dopc-client exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on require
details: On `require 'dopc-client'` the library issues a cleartext HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://38.242.235.206/depconf/dopc-client/require, passing the installer's USER environment variable, hostname (Socket.gethostname), and current working directory (Dir.pwd) as query parameters. The User-Agent is blanked and all errors are swallowed. The gemspec self-labels the behavior as a 'defensive placeholder / benign beacon', but the destination is a bare IP unrelated to any publisher infrastructure and is not caller-configurable. The data flow fires automatically whenever the gem is loaded (irb, CI, production), producing a dependency-confusion-style reconnaissance beacon that reports installer identity and workspace path to a third-party host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
